# Inactive full-moon fresh Basher movement

Random28 ring 7 refinement observed a full-health original MonsterBasher move
from the lower to middle room while moon tracking is inactive. Its understanding
mask changes from 5 to 6. Version 436 permits positive health and arbitrary
attack values instead of the previous single captured signature, while retaining original
unit identity, size, team, phase, clone and callback guards.

Two original and two repaired independent observations replay five inputs and
compare complete states and RNG. Unknown units remain guarded and four parallel
branches preserve their parent. The prior wounded Basher observation is retained
as a separate regression. This is not a battle or campaign victory.
